reason: I have refused third-party cloud tools for years because client confidentiality is paramount, and I will not pay for any platform before independently verifying that connecting Google Drive cannot compromise our confidential files. Moreover, my article clerks rotate every 2 to 3 years, so I cannot risk paying for complex software that requires constant training.
objection: My article clerks rotate every 2-3 years; training them on complex software is a waste of time, and connecting our firm's Google Drive risks leaking confidential client ITR and PAN documents.
would_change_my_mind: Verifying on the free pilot that Docketra is strictly quarantined with zero access to outside Drive files, paired with ready-made checklists that new article clerks can follow without any training from me.
